title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Long Beach
description: Ten under-21-safe Long Beach food stops with late service documented by current official location pages; access modes and closing times vary by destination.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Bellflower Booth
cards.subtitle: All-night diner service on Bellflower Boulevard
cards.notes: Head north on Bellflower Boulevard for a sit-down diner option; confirm holiday service before making the late trip.
cards.short_summary: An official 24-hour diner listing on the campus-side Bellflower corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official Long Beach directory lists the restaurant at 2860 N Bellflower Blvd as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Denny's Locations in Long Beach, California
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently says open 24 hours. Holiday schedules can differ; call ahead when timing is critical.

cards.title: The PCH All-Nighter
cards.subtitle: A round-the-clock diner east of campus
cards.notes: Use Pacific Coast Highway for this all-hours stop, and check the official listing again if traveling on a holiday.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner option along the commercial PCH corridor east of CSULB.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official Long Beach directory lists the restaurant at 5570 Pacific Coast Highway as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Denny's Locations in Long Beach, California
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently says open 24 hours. Verify holiday service and transportation before departing late.

cards.title: The Atlantic Avenue Diner Run
cards.subtitle: Twenty-four-hour service north of central Long Beach
cards.notes: Save this Atlantic Avenue address for an all-night sit-down option; arrange a safe ride for the longer cross-town run.

cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official Long Beach directory lists the restaurant at 3333 Atlantic Ave as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Denny's Locations in Long Beach, California
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently says open 24 hours. This is a cross-town destination; confirm holiday hours and travel plans.

cards.title: The Downtown 24-Hour Table
cards.subtitle: All-night diner service near Seventh Street
cards.notes: Pair this downtown address with a planned ride home; use the official directory to recheck service around holidays.

cards.source_title: Denny's Locations in Long Beach, California
cards.access_notes: Official directory currently says open 24 hours. Plan transportation downtown and verify holiday service before leaving.

cards.title: The Stearns Avenue Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Late service east of the CSULB campus
cards.notes: Check your transportation before heading east: the official page documents late drive-through service, not late dine-in access.
cards.short_summary: A nearby late-order option whose overnight hours apply specifically to the drive-through.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page lists drive-through hours of 7:00 a.m.–5:00 a.m. every day at 6407 Stearns Ave.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 6407 Stearns Ave., Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is officially listed until 5:00 a.m. daily. Late dine-in is not documented; confirm vehicle and ordering access.

cards.title: The Norwalk Boulevard Night Window
cards.subtitle: Drive-through service until 3 or 4 a.m.
cards.notes: Use this only with suitable drive-through access; the dining room closes at midnight while vehicle service continues later.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-through on the east side with later Friday and Saturday closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists drive-through service until 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 3398 Norwalk Blvd, Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 3:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed only to midnight.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell — 2500 E Pacific Coast Hwy
cards.title: The PCH Two-A.M. Stop
cards.subtitle: Late drive-through with an earlier dining-room cutoff
cards.notes: Arrive before 11 p.m. for documented dine-in access; after that, confirm you can safely use the drive-through ordering channel.
cards.short_summary: A PCH location separating midnight-hour drive-through service from earlier indoor access.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists the drive-through until 2:00 a.m. daily and dine-in service until 11:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant at 2500 E Pacific Coast Hwy, Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is listed until 2:00 a.m. daily; dine-in is listed until 11:00 p.m. Confirm the available ordering mode.

cards.source_title: Jack in the Box at 2550 N Lakewood Blvd, Long Beach
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday and midnight otherwise; lobby hours end at 10:00 p.m.
